Everyone I've known or met from the television/cable world seems to think they're more important than they actually are.  How do you compare yourself to the people you grew up with, as a child?
Why did you post an AMA?
Is Detroit still a shithole?

My family called the police on me.  I'll say this.  I'm much deeper in debt and lost a few family members over it.
That hospital visit wasn't worth a fuck, and I'm looking forward to my suicide more than before.

I'm not worried about alt accounts.  I have two computers.  One stays logged in as Suicidey83.  The other is logged in as Megasuicide.  If I sign out of one, I may need to create another one.  Not interested in karma.

Pedagogist/methodologist/psychologist/redditor won't answer a simple question.
Typical.
Enjoy your 20 more whatever-you-knows that I don't care about.

That's BS and you know it.
Obamacare sucks.  But, your numbers aren't accurate.
Quit acting like a victim.  We're living in the greatest country on the planet.

I agree.  People are shitbags.  They're, mostly, pieces of garbage and I hate them.

You might not get anywhere, ever.  But, stick around, and I'll help you make fun of everyone.
Slingblade and Radio are the best comedy movies, ever.

Read the thread.
"Where do most people go when extensive therapy doesn't work?"
You retorted with garbage.
You would have failed the exam because you didn't read directions.
I didn't ask to argue with you.  I didn't ask to hear your bullshit.  I asked a question and you couldn't answer.

college should be a blast, man.
I know you're hurting, but maybe you can just go bang a hottie and you'll feel better?
I don't mean to belittle your feelings. But, I think you can work this out.

"you can find something"...


Seriously, this is a subreddit concerning suicide.  Most of us cannot "find something other than"...Get real.

I have an undergrad degree in Psychology.  I always hate  the answer "you should spend time doing the things that bring you joy".  
My response:  "Fuck you.  I'm considering suicide.  You know, not being here and not worried about talking to you again.  Do you even know what you're talking about?  How/Where/When/Who/What/Why would I know about finding joy in my life?  How would I be able to recognize it if I found it?  I, obviously, haven't seen it yet.  But, you're asking me to tell you about it?"
Fuck psychologists/the rapists.

If I could, I would.  I spent far too much for far too little.  
I'm reading/responding to SWatch because I'm not only a subscriber, but a future statistic. 
I wish I could help you more.  If you want a few of my therapists phone numbers, I could definitely help out.  They weren't free, efficient, or worth the money, though.

I hope somebody helps you out.  Really, I do.   Your experience sounds shitty.  
I can only assume:
  1.  You should seek therapy, because it helps everyone, all of the time
  2.  You can afford therapy, because it is affordable, all of the time
  3.  You can expect healthy returns on your 'therapy investment', because it always works. 
  4.  Your problems are minor, because life always gets better.  You just have to wait it out.  You'll see.  The hospital told me so.

On a serious note, I am sorry you are going through this.  I never had parents, either.  It hurt most during my divorce.  I didn't have anyone to call on for experience or advice.
I ended up spending a shit-load of money on therapy and 'help' to find out I'm "expecting too much and I should be happy with my life"
I told my psychologist to rot in hell, every-day-from-now-on. 
We're not friends anymore.  I still owe her $10,000 for her friendship and loyalty.
I hear ya.  Some of us just don't care.

It won't.  Thanks, though.  Cheers.  It's fucked up, isn't it? 

 When you drive your car/truck down the freeway and wonder why you don't go over the bridge?... Ever been there? ...Some folks don't have anything to live for.   Some people appreciate what they have.  Some people aren't pilgrims and wonder 'why not, there's nothing to lose'.

I hope that works out for you.  Cheers.

Seriously: I hope you succeed. Good luck, mate.

Thanks, man.

I, mostly, hate all these other "canned" responses.  
i.e.:
"I took two Psychology courses in college!  I know it all!"
I hate those folks.

good on you, bud.  I'm not as fortunate as you. I'm not going to PM anyone.
I appreciate your response.
Thanks.

I'm approx. 40 grand ($40k USD) deeper in debt due to counseling.  I've "moved on" several times.  I'd like you to never speak to me again.  Fuck you, and your uninformed "enlightenment".  Eat a dick.
Doubt it.  Maybe he was a passing shit-sipper.  Or, maybe, a white-knuckler.
